data.name: Limning Verse
data.description: The argent voice can sing a song that causes fiends to glow with an aura of silvery light. Outsiders with the evil subtype within %1 feet of the argent voice are affected as per faerie fire. Any defense that prevents the detection of alignment or evil also prevents limning verse from outlining a creature. The argent voice must use Perform (sing) with this performance.|LimningVerseRange
